name: Pale Rider
bible: A slight, quiet young woman, small and light, a head shorter than the other riders, with a calm face: pale skin, deep-set dark eyes with a faint violet tint, a small straight nose and a tight, unsmiling mouth. Short tousled brown hair, side-swept with one stray tuft over the ear, ending at the jaw. A long dark charcoal-violet hooded cloak with a ragged hem reaching the calves, over a plum-black high-collared coat. A deep red wool scarf at her throat. Heavy bronze chains with dark iron links cross her chest and loop at the hip. Black leather trousers, dark brown ankle boots with bronze buckles, black fingerless gloves. WEAPON: a slender war scythe about as tall as her head and shoulders, with a black bramble-wrapped haft studded with tiny thorns, and a narrow, sickle-thin blade of smoke-black steel whose inner edge is serrated with thorn-like points that glow violet. Both hands grip it: the RIGHT low on the haft, the LEFT high near the blade's neck; the blade always leads to the right. Trails and smoke are VIOLET-PURPLE. Her summons (a smoky hound, Death's PALE HORSE) never appear in standing or attacking poses.
design:
- top row: full-body neutral stance facing right; a standing idle with the scythe planted butt-first; a walking pose; a running pose with the scythe over the shoulder
- upper middle row: a low crouch; a wide low reaping sweep with a violet arc; a fast diagonal reap from overhead
- lower middle row: a mid-air dive-slash; a plunge with the blade driven down; a low spinning reap skimming the ground; a long dragging hook
- bottom row: standing guard with the scythe across the body; a hit reaction; knocked down; a victory pose with the scythe planted; the Pale Horse Rift Art (her riding Death's pale horse down in a slam)
- inset at the top right: the shadow hound alone in side view, large and dark with violet glowing eyes, its shoulder height about her head height, in the same style, as an identity reference only
- inset at the top left: the scythe alone, small, showing the bramble-wrapped haft and the thin thorned blade from the side
- all figures share one costume, one scythe design and one scale
- the hound and the pale horse appear only in their special moves and the inset

sheetNotes.idle: Thornmaw stands with the scythe planted butt-first on the ground beside her right foot, the haft leaning against her left shoulder and the blade curving up over her head. Her head is bowed a little, her weight light, the cloak sways with each breath. No hound in this pose.
sheetNotes.run: She carries the scythe over her left shoulder with the haft across it and the blade trailing behind her. Light, fast steps, the cloak and the chains swinging.
sheetNotes.dash: Ground dash: low and fast, the scythe tucked under her arm with its blade trailing violet smoke. Air dash: body stretched forward, the scythe pulled in close, cloak snapping behind.
sheetNotes.art: Pale Horse (Rift Art): Death's pale horse rises out of her shadow, she rides it into a leap onto the opponent and they slam down together. The pale horse is a gaunt, ghostly horse of bone-white and ash-grey with a thin smoky white mane and tail, hollow violet-glowing eyes, its hooves trailing violet-black smoke; seen from the side, never bigger than its cell allows, its back at about her shoulder height; it exists only in these six frames. Frame 1: she crouches low with the scythe held back, the pale horse rising out of a pool of violet-black shadow beside her, violet motes lifting. Frame 2: the pale horse fully risen and rearing, its eyes lit, she grips its mane to vault up, the scythe raised. Frame 3: mounted on the pale horse, both launch into a high leap toward the right, dark shadow trails behind them. Frame 4: the slam: the horse comes down hooves-first onto the opponent at the right of the cell while she drives the scythe point-first into the ground, a dark shockwave and violet cracks spreading across the floor. Frame 5: the horse dissolves into pale smoke, she pulls the scythe out of the ground, violet shards floating. Frame 6: she rises back into her calm stance, the last wisp of the pale horse fading. The whole composition, horse included, stays inside each cell.
sheetNotes.misc: Taunt: she lifts the scythe one-handed and turns its blade once above her head in a slow violet arc, then lowers it and tilts her head with a quiet, unsettling half-smile. Victory: she plants the scythe butt-first in front of her, both hands on the haft, bowing her head; violet motes rise from the thorns of the blade.
sheetNotes.ko: Intro: she walks in slowly with the scythe dragging by its butt and the blade low; she lifts it to her shoulder, spins it once in a tight quick flourish, and settles into her stance with the blade set forward.
sheetNotes.skill: Plague Hound, her own special (a shadow hound races along the ground; its bite slows and sickens). The shadow hound is a summon made from smoke and violet-green plague mist, dark and unlit, and it is not the pale horse of her Rift Art. She holds the war scythe in both hands. 1: she crouches with the scythe held low, its violet-glowing blade down by the ground, the cloak drawn in. 2: she plants the haft and pulls back, a dark shadow hound beginning to form at her feet out of violet smoke. 3: she sweeps the scythe forward and the shadow hound leaps out and charges low along the ground. 4: the hound racing at full force low along the floor, sickly violet-green plague mist trailing behind it, the scythe pointed forward. 5: the hound dissolving into violet smoke, the mist thinning. 6: she rises back to stance, the scythe held low.
sheetNotes.alt-a: THIS SHEET SHOWS HIS/HER SECOND FIGHTING STANCE. In EVERY frame the weapon is her COLOSSAL SHADOW: a towering spectral shadow beast (a horse-headed shadow with burning violet eyes and huge claws) that rises from the ground behind her and strikes for her - NOT the usual weapon from the reference images (the costume, face, hair and colours stay exactly as the reference). How it is held: she stands small and still in front, the scythe held loosely; the giant shadow behind her makes every attack, its claws and jaws reaching far IN FRONT of her (kept inside the cell).
